dataset: VID: A Comprehensive Dataset for Violence Detection in Various Contexts

eligibility.decisionScope: Explicit dataset copyright permission for controlled experimental training, including a commercially compatible future copyright use.
eligibility.basis: The creators' official released dataset deposit declares CC0-1.0, with no additional use/access restrictions in its public metadata.

deposit.access: Public metadata and unrestricted files; no account, request form or agreement acceptance was performed for this audit.

paper.purposeWordingSummary: The data-access instructions describe academic, research or instructional purposes. This wording does not contain an only qualifier and is not an additional restriction in the released deposit metadata.

consent.ethicsCommittee: Research Ethics Committee of the University of Asia Pacific

paper.countDiscrepancy: The deposit description says 3000 source clips; the article says 3020 source clips and 6040 files including derivatives. Neither count has been confirmed by archive inventory in this audit.

archiveInterpretation.nvPrefix: Nonviolent class; infer from names and the paper, verify against archive contents.
archiveInterpretation.v_cPrefix: Classroom violence class; infer from names and the paper, verify against archive contents.
archiveInterpretation.groupingRule: An original recording and all transformed, masked, cropped or near-duplicate versions must share a sourceGroup and split. Do not count raw and masked versions as independent recordings.
archiveInterpretation.labelScope: Publisher scene labels distinguish violence/nonviolence and broad contexts. They do not independently establish contact, intent, injury, identity or event-level timing.

copyrightLimitations.note: CC0 is explicit copyright permission, not a guarantee that every non-copyright right has been cleared. Preserve the author-reported consent and purpose-wording caveats in provenance.

excludedAlternatives.reason: The official dataset release agreement grants research and educational use, with no verified commercially compatible media grant. The article's CC BY licence does not replace the dataset terms.

The official dataset terms require SMIIP Lab approval for commercial use and for modification/redistribution. No such permission was obtained. Existing checkpoint/code licences do not supply those media rights.

The official source limits access/use to approved academic noncommercial research and restricts commercial use, redistribution and derived datasets without permission. No account, release agreement or approval was obtained.
